Subject: Private VPC architecture review - next steps

Hi Sarah / Michael,

Thanks again for the discovery call today 

really helpful to understand Acme Health's requirements for a private VPC/on-prem deployment. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Goals we heard: fully isolated VPC deployment, customer-managed KMS, audit log retention for 3 years, and support for burst GPU capacity during peak inference windows.
- Primary success criteria: ability to run inference within your VPC with private networking + SLAs for latency and availability, and a documented security posture for procurement.

Next step: schedule a 60-min architecture review / technical deep-dive with our Solutions Engineering team to map the exact network, IAM, and deployment requirements. Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue Apr 23, 10:00 - 11:00am
- Tue Apr 23, 2:00 - 3:00pm
- Wed Apr 24, 9:00 - 10:00am

Please let me know which slot works (or propose alternatives) and who from your side will join (infra/network/security). I'll include Nikhil (SE) and Marissa (CS) on the invite.

I've attached a short network requirements template to help your infra team prepare (network_requirements.docx). Also linking our SOC 2 summary and a short checklist so we can hit the ground running: https://redwood.ai/soc2-report

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
